name: Nanao (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nanao city emblem in blue and light blue: a blue stylised letter G with a light blue stylised figure.
history: Municipal flag of Nanao, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2004.
